description: This file defines the setup wizard configuration for integrating Nextcloud Talk into a system, including setup steps, credentials handling, and configuration validation.

classes.name: ChannelSetupWizard
classes.description: Type definition for the setup wizard object for a communication channel.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares the setup by optionally prompting for API credentials.

methods.name: inspect
methods.description: Inspects current credential configuration for display or validation.

methods.name: applyUseEnv
methods.description: Applies environment variable settings to the account configuration.

methods.name: applySet
methods.description: Sets specific credential values in the account configuration.
